Explore MKII

探索 MKII 行星 · 162 词 · 2 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1MKII, a planet billions of kilometers away, is considered the origin of life in many religions. Physicists have found that its gentle climate and the pull of its gravity are similar to those of Earth. Using satellites, astronomers have found that oxygen and carbon dioxide exist in its atmosphere and play fundamental roles in life as we know it. Cheered up by this news, biologists began their own research to solve the puzzle. If some conditions are suitable for life, is there really life on this planet? If so, how do its creatures multiply? Do they lay eggs or give birth?

2Last month, a spaceship was sent there. It’s a pity that this mission failed. Unlike Earth, MKII is a much younger planet. Thus, masses of harmful acidic clouds float everywhere, setting off violent chain reactions. These clouds not only blocked out the pilots’ sight but also damaged the engine system. Luckily, the pilots stayed alert and managed to avert a crash.

探索 MKII 行星

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1MKII 是一颗远在数十亿公里之外的行星，许多宗教把那里视为生命的起源。物理学家发现，它的气候温和，引力也和地球相近。天文学家借助卫星发现，它的大气里有氧气和二氧化碳，这两种气体对我们所知的生命都很重要。这个消息让生物学家很振奋，他们接着做起研究，想解开大家的疑问：既然有一些适合生命的条件，这颗行星上真的有生物吗？它们靠产卵繁殖，还是直接生下幼崽？

2上个月，一艘飞船被派往那里，可惜任务失败了。MKII 比地球年轻得多，大团有害的酸性云到处漂浮，引发剧烈的连锁反应。这些云不仅遮住了飞行员的视线，还损坏了发动机系统。幸亏飞行员一直小心留意，及时避免了飞船坠毁。
